canonical_statement: Every smooth finite-dimensional Hausdorff second-countable Riemannian manifold without boundary admits a smooth isometric embedding into some finite-dimensional Euclidean space.

canonical_formal_target.declaration_or_expression: A Prop quantifying over a finite-dimensional smooth manifold M with Riemannian metric g and asserting the existence of N and a smooth embedding f : M -> EuclideanSpace Real (Fin N) with pullback metric f*e = g

domain_and_universes: A universe-polymorphic carrier M equipped with the exact mathlib topological, smooth-manifold, finite-dimensional, and Riemannian structures selected in the statement phase; N : Nat
quantifiers: the smooth finite-dimensional manifold structure and Riemannian metric g on M
existential f : M -> EuclideanSpace Real (Fin N)
hypotheses: M is a finite-dimensional smooth manifold without boundary
g is a smooth positive-definite Riemannian metric
conclusion: There exist finite N and a smooth embedding f into Euclidean N-space such that the pullback of its standard Euclidean metric is g.

excluded_degenerate_cases: The root excludes manifolds with boundary/corners, pseudo-Riemannian and infinite-dimensional metrics, mere immersions, approximate metric preservation, and the distinct C1 Nash-Kuiper theorem.
